name: irrigate mild chemical burn
description: Flush the affected tissue thoroughly to remove remaining corrosive material.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate the chemical burn.

name: irrigate moderate chemical burn
description: Flush the injured tissue with a large quantity of water to remove the corrosive contaminant.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate the chemical burn.

name: irrigate deep chemical burn
description: Continuously flush the severely damaged tissue to remove as much corrosive material as possible.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate the deep chemical burn.

name: irrigate severe chemical burn
description: Use a large volume of water to flush the extensively chemically damaged tissue, then protect the exposed area with a heavy burn dressing.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate and protect the severe chemical burn.

name: debride irrigated full-thickness chemical burn
description: After corrosive material has been flushed away, remove loose nonviable tissue and protect the remaining full-thickness chemical burn.
success_msg: You debride and dress the irrigated full-thickness chemical burn.

name: irrigate extensive chemical burn
description: Use a very large volume of water to stop continuing chemical exposure across the extensive injury, then protect the damaged tissue.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate and protect the extensive chemical burn.

name: debride irrigated extensive chemical burn
description: After the chemical exposure has been stopped, remove extensive nonviable tissue and protect the large remaining wound.
success_msg: You debride and heavily dress the extensive chemical burn.
